checkpoint_approvals.comment: Approved as Functional Analyst; story points confirmed at 5 (revised from 3 after the scope review). Incorporates the maintainer's actors/ folder decision (ADR-007 §3.5/§4 delegates the layout to this US) and the reviewer's five suggestions (SP, hard prerequisite, canonical mermaid home, AC split, non-signing actor). Authorizes decomposition into 3 candidate functional Bolts.

Re-approved (material change, G15): Actor reframed as producer+approver — a team member who PRODUCES the governed artifacts its role owns (FA→US, architect→ADR, developer→SPEC+code, QA→TC/tests) in executor mode AND participates in AITL approvals in approver mode under the independence floor; no longer merely 'the participant who occupies a checkpoint pause'. Consistent with ADR-007 (modes:executor) and ADR-008 — no ADR change. Grammar/independence/open roles/safe-default/actors/ folder preserved; canonical mermaid replaced. First approval (13:22:43) kept as history. Bolts unchanged.
